3. Do not Powergame Powergaming is using an in-game mechanic or game knowledge to give your own character an advantage at the expense of everyone else. Powergaming can take several forms, but is generally rooted in playing to win or focusing on playing the game instead of roleplay. Playing your character should always be more important than playing the game.
- Cool things that have a side benefit of player-character empowerment or just cool methods of empowering your character are acceptable when done sparingly. If done to a point to where it becomes a detriment to the server, action will be taken.
- Examples - It is fine to: - Swap your cheap sunglasses for regular sunglasses because your character "isn't a cheapskate." - Set up a remote signaller to bolt your room shut IF your character has been attacked previously. - Request a pistol and permit from security because your character believes in "the right to bear arms." - Give out temporary accesses in order to get the station operational. - Give out weapons in an instance where there is a major crisis and no security personel to deal with it. - It isn't fine to: - Take multiple command kits/command items that aren't neccessary for the station to survive, even if you are the only command member. - Switch the current alert level to one that's proceedures/purpose doesn't make sense and calling the shuttle due to that alert level calling the shuttle faster. - Stealing the headset of Syndicate Refugees to get access to the Syndicate radio line. - Granting all-access to multiple crew members for no reason other than "efficiency." - Giving crew members full sets of weaponry when no threat is present.
